text:
oliver_marketing: Quick sync: were green to publish the benchmarks next Tue at 17:00 PT / 00:00 UTC, but partners in SEA asked for a 30m earlier pickup due to time zones. Need sign-off on controlled pre-release and partner asset rules.

nate_pr: Who are the SEA partners requesting earlier access? We only allow pre-release for vetted outlets with embargo agreements.

geo_partnerships: Partners: codeinsights.sg and apac-devnews. Both have existing NDAs; theyre asking for 23:30 UTC pickup. Can we do a single early pickup for those two?

anya_local: Localization note: if we do an early pickup at 23:30 UTC, translations for ID/PH languages are tight. We can support only ZH-CN and JA in time.

anita_legal: Legal ok with controlled pre-release for 2 partners provided they sign the embargo addendum (we have templates). Require explicit list + contact emails before we grant.

sophie_marketing: Proposed rule: early pickup allowed for up to 3 vetted partners, assets limited to PNGs and the partner summary (no raw CSVs), and no screenshots of internal dashboards. We should add that to the partner FAQ.

pressops_bot: Reminder: embargo checklist items outstanding: partner addendum signed, partner FAQ posted, tracking params finalized. Use /release-checklist to update status.

nate_pr: I'll reach out to the two SEA partners and request signed addendum by EOD today. If they can't sign, no early pickup. Also will offer an embargoed briefing instead.

oliver_marketing: Sounds good. Sophie, can you update the FAQ with the early-pickup clause and asset whitelist?

sophie_marketing: Will do. Draft FAQ snippet: "Early pickup: granted only to pre-approved partners (max 3). Assets allowed: PNG graphs, one-paragraph summary. CSVs and raw logs are not permitted until public release." Posting here in 10m for sign-off.

geo_partnerships: I'll DM contact emails in 5. Please confirm we have the addendum ready.

anita_legal: Addendum template is ready. I'll prep an expedited sign-off flow and batch-send to partners once Nate confirms list.

pressops_bot: Action items: [nate_pr  request addendum signatures], [sophie_marketing  update partner FAQ], [anita_legal  batch-send addendum], [anya_local  scope translations]. ETA T-24h.

nate_pr: Sent initial emails. codeinsights.sg replied and asked whether they can get interview time with an engineer; sending scheduling options.

oliver_marketing: If they want an engineer slot, keep it short (15m) and schedule after we have re-run numbers. No deep-dive on internals.

sophie_marketing: FAQ posted (link: /docs/partner-faq). Copy of early-pickup clause in thread. Please review.

anita_legal: Received partner list. Sending addendum now.

pressops_bot: Status update: addendum signed by codeinsights.sg; apac-devnews pending. Syndication hold set for all channels until public go.

oliver_marketing: Great work. We'll close this thread once all addenda are collected. Keep comms in-thread to maintain embargo control.

nate_pr: Will follow up with apac-devnews and report back here. :thumbsup:

sophie_marketing: Thanks team. Posting final publish schedule to the release doc shortly."
